Write a data card for a masked clone

Source: R/data_card.R
data_card.Rd

Describes a clone in a data card (card version 0.1): its size, its design columns and, for each column, a role, a kind and counts. An analysis planner can read the card in place of the data. No value of any column is written: a factor's levels are counted, never listed.

Usage

data_card(
  m,
  file = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  env = NULL,
  spatial = NULL,
  unit = NULL,
  primary_event = 1L
)

Arguments

m

A masque object from mask(), or a masque_set from mask_set().

file

Where to write the card in YAML, or NULL (the default) to write nothing. For a set, a directory, which receives one file per table named <table>.data_card.yaml.

name

The table name on the card. Defaults to "clone" for a single table, and to the table names for a set (where name may give one name per table, in order). A name must start with a letter and hold only letters, digits, _ and .. Any other name is refused with masque_bad_card_name_refusal, never cleaned.

env, spatial, unit

Optional names of clone columns: the environment columns (trials, sites, years), the columns giving a spatial or temporal position, and the one column identifying the unit of repeated measurement. Environment columns must have the role design. For a set, a named list giving the columns per table. A name that is not a column of the clone is refused with masque_bad_card_column_refusal.

primary_event

Which event pair of the first events spec is the card's event time and status, counted in the order the events occur. Ignored when the clone has no events spec.

Value

The card as a list, invisibly when file is given. For a set, a named list of cards, one per table.

Details

The card is computed from the clone alone: synthetic(), the role table from roles(), the mode, the package version and the column names of any events spec given to mask(). No other part of the private recipe is read, so the card can travel with the clone. On a clone whose column names were aliased, the card uses the aliases throughout.

Design block

The design block is copied from the role table, never re-detected. The treatment columns are those with the role treatment, and the block columns those with the role design, less any named in env, spatial or unit. Environment, spatial and unit columns are named by the caller, since the role table does not tell them apart from blocks. No design class is written. For a linked-event spec, the event pair chosen by primary_event gives the event time and status columns, the other status columns of that spec are listed as competing, and the card records the number of rows with the primary status equal to 1 and the share of rows with neither the primary nor a competing event (censored).

Provenance

Every statistic carries a provenance class.

  • structure: exact in the clone, so equal to the same statistic on the original table. Row and column counts, missing counts and shares, the level counts and zero shares of kept and aliased columns and of event status columns, the treatment, block and event columns, the environment count and the event count.

  • clone_estimate: re-simulated, so approximate. The level counts and zero shares of scrambled columns, including event times, and the censored share.

  • analyst: named in this call: the environment, spatial and unit columns.

The YAML file

The card is written by a small deterministic writer: keys in the order of the contract, every string double-quoted and escaped, counts as integers, shares with six decimals, UTF-8 with \n line ends. The same clone gives the same bytes.

See also

roles(), synthetic(), mask(), mask_set().

Examples

r <- propose_roles(iris)
r <- set_role(r, "Species", role = "treatment", action = "alias")
r <- set_role(r, "Sepal.Length", role = "outcome")
m <- mask(iris, r, seed = 1)
card <- data_card(m)
card$table
#> $name
#> [1] "clone"
#> 
#> $source
#> [1] "clone"
#> 
#> $n_rows
#> [1] 150
#> 
#> $n_cols
#> [1] 5
#> 
#> $provenance
#> $provenance$n_rows
#> [1] "structure"
#> 
#> $provenance$n_cols
#> [1] "structure"
#> 
#> 
card$design
#> $treatment_cols
#> [1] "Species"
#> 
#> $provenance
#> $provenance$treatment_cols
#> [1] "structure"
#> 
#> 

path <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml")
data_card(m, file = path)
head(readLines(path), 12)
#>  [1] "card_version: \"0.1\""     "produced_by:"             
#>  [3] "  package: \"masque\""     "  version: \"0.16.0\""    
#>  [5] "  mode: \"local\""         "table:"                   
#>  [7] "  name: \"clone\""         "  source: \"clone\""      
#>  [9] "  n_rows: 150"             "  n_cols: 5"              
#> [11] "  provenance:"             "    n_rows: \"structure\""
